title: Arata: The Legend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world where humans and gods coexist, Arata, a boy disguised as a princess candidate of the matriarchal Hime clan, is framed for the princess's murder and swaps places with Arata Hinohara, a bullied boy from modern Japan (Viz blurb; MangaUpdates). Hinohara is sent to a prison colony and learns he can wield a Hayagami sword, while the other Arata lives in Tokyo in his place (School Library Journal review). Viz published 24 volumes; the original run was paused and later remastered (AniList note).
life_message: It holds up courage, trust and finding self-worth after betrayal and bullying.

content.note: Rated Teen 13+ for fantasy violence; sword fights, assassinations, a murdered princess (SLJ review; MangaUpdates Assassination/s).
Prison colony under a sadistic warden; hunted protagonist (SLJ review).
